newsitem.title: USA: U.S. children left with mother's body for 10 days.
newsitem.headline: U.S. children left with mother's body for 10 days.

text.p: Police said on Monday they were hunting for a father suspected of killing his wife and leaving his two terrified children alone with the body in a house for 10 days.

The tragedy came to light on Sunday when a Sacramento grocery store security guard confronted an 8-year-old boy for stealing food. Police went to the home and found the mother's decomposing body in the bedroom, where they believe she had been since about Oct. 1, police spokesman Michael Heenan said.

The mother, 38-year-old Janice Castroena, had a stab wound to the chest and a knife was lying nearby, he said. The father, Robert Castroena, also 38, is believed to have left the house about 10 days ago, leaving the 8-year-old boy and his 14-year-old sister, whose names were not released, alone.

Police have launched a nationwide manhunt for Castroena on suspicion of murder and assault with a deadly weapon for threatening the children. Castroena, a social sciences teacher, quit his job at a Sacramento high school in September, local news reports said.
Heenan said the couple had an argument about Oct. 1. When the father emerged from the room the next day, he told the children "not to disturb their mother," Heenan said.

Over the next two or three days, the father was in and out of the house. Heenan said the father terrorised the children at knifepoint and told the girl he was going to kill her. Both begged for their lives, he said.
The father left a few days later but "the children were convinced the door could open at any minute and it might be him. They were very much afraid for their lives," Heenan said.
Neighbours noticed nothing unusual and the children were home-schooled so their absence was not noticed, Heenan said.
The children were healthy and uninjured but deeply traumatized, Heenan said. They were being cared for, he added.
The motive for the killing was unclear.
